svg.title: Product recipes and production capacity
svg.desc: Product recipes and production capacity. Which item, component, operation, and work center define production? Primary tables: BillOfMaterial, BillOfMaterialLine, Routing, RoutingOperation, WorkCenter, WorkCenterCalendar. BOM and routing definitions support planned work. Their existence does not establish material issue, completion, or cost close.
